def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    centers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=3 and any(0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==3 for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)])]
    for orient in (0,1): # horiz then vert
        for r,c,color in centers:
            for sign in (-1,1):
                rr,cc=r,c
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    if grid[rr][cc]==3:
                        if (rr,cc) not in {(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}:
                            break
                    else:
                        out[rr][cc]=color
                    rr+= (sign if orient==1 else 0)
                    cc+= (sign if orient==0 else 0)
    return out

def mkgrid(h,w, objs):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in objs:
        g[r][c]=v
        for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:g[r+dr][c+dc]=3
    return g
# demo2 centers
